reference.difference_orientation: alternative action loss minus base action loss; negative favors alternative
reference.scientific_validation_source: reference_validation.json: measured-run prefix and full-stream comparisons
reference.scope: Unrestricted fixed-state 512-bank prefixes are descriptive conditional comparisons, not actual stopped online replays or population certificates.

gain_orientation: baseline loss minus subject loss; positive favors subject
timing: All root cost.total_process_cpu is used once. Gate costs already overlap these totals and are not added again. Wall times are descriptive, not uncertainty or confidence estimates.
limitations: Missing physical outcomes keep all 72 roots with [0, loss_cap] bounds; they are not imputed as failures.
Conditional-bank empirical missing-outcome bounds are not population or anytime confidence bounds.
CPU stopping can depend on trajectory complexity. Larger banks are new simulated draws, not new dates.
No per-root method, budget or implementation oracle is reported.
Novelty and route closure are evaluated separately from measured quality and throughput.
